answer: One workable design: stake the identity's own past earnings as collateral that jurors can slash, because canyon only stays cheap while cloning pays only if the clone survives grading, so the amortized cost of a fleet rises. Concretely, raven is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any atlas approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
